items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: I used to tell Marco, take me over to see the Bulls off Parade.

ctx.x: And then, and they were all, all, all marching and having, had a wonderful band, see, all the time. I listened to that band all the time, and Marco, I said, I used to tell Marco, take me over to see the Bulls off Parade. So, all these guys were dressed in full dress suits, you understand? Mm-hmm. I used to call it Swallowtail Coach, you know? Yeah. And they were dressed like, like, like, like guys in a minstrel. And, and for, they, they had that, that, that, that hi-hat and everything else. And they were…
